324: And we learned: The Jubilee, in which slaves go out to freedom, is united in this mind; and those fifty years of the Jubilee and those fifty days of the count of the Omer are united in it. For the spirits of the slaves rest in them, and their spirits go out (another textual version: its spirit goes out) to rest, as it is written (Isaiah 14:3), "on the day that the Lord shall give rest from your sorrow and trouble, and from the bondage, etc." And because of this, the hay (the second letter of the four letter name of God) is where the spirit rests, and it is what takes the spirit out to freedom. So the exodus from Egypt depends on that container (of the tefillin that is associated with that letter), as it does with the letter, hay, of the holy name, as has been said. To here is the general principle of yod-hay (the first two letters) of the holy name.
